ji: -Ji (adj.--suffix) [From jayati to conquer] 이긴, 승리의: sangāma° 싸움에서 승리한, in sangāmaj' uttama "가장 뛰어난 정복자" Dh 103; sabba° S IV.83.
-Ji (adj.--suffix) [From jayati to conquer] 이긴, 승리의: sangāma° 싸움에서 승리한, in sangāmaj' uttama "가장 뛰어난 정복자" Dh 103; sabba° S IV.83.
jigiṃsaka: Jigiṁsaka (adj.) [see next] 얻고자 하는, 바라는, 추구하는 사람 Sn 690.
jigiṃsati: Jigiṁsati [Desid. of ji, jayati. On etym. see also Kern, Toev. p. 44] 바라다, 얻고 싶어하다, 탐하다; Sn 700; J II.285; III.172 (v. l. BB. jigissaṁ); IV.406 (v. l. SS. jihiṁ?‹, BB. jigī°); V.372; VI.268. As jigīsati Th 1, 1110.
jigiṃsanatā: Jigiṁsanatā (f.) [n. abstr. fr. jigiṁsati] ~에 대한 욕망, 탐욕 Vbh 353 (v. l. BB. nijigīsanatā); cp. Vism. 29
jigucchaka: Jigucchaka (adj.) ~을 싫어하거나 인정하지 않는 사람 M I.327 (paṭhavī°, āpa° etc.) Miln 343.
jigucchati: Jigucchati [Desid. of gup] 피하다, 도망치다, 역겨워하다, 혐오하다, ~을 역겨워하다 혹은 ~에 공포를 느끼다 (c. instr.) D I.213 (iddhi--pāṭihāriyena aṭṭiyāmi harāyāmi j.): A IV.174 (kāyaduccaritena); Sn 215 (kammehi pāpakehi; SnA 266=hiriyati); J II.287; Pug. 36. -- ppr. jigucchamāna It 43; grd. jigucchitabba A I.126; pp. jigucchita Sn 901. -- See also jeguccha, jegucchin.
jigucchana: Jigucchana (nt.) 싫어함, 멸시, 역겨움 Vism 159; PvA 120.
jigucchā: Jigucchā (f.) ~에 대한 역겨움, 방지, 혐오, 회피: tapo° (금욕주의를 혐오하는) D I.174; S I.67; A II.200; jigucchabībhaccha--dassana 혐오스럽고 & 두려운 모습 PvA 56. Note. A diff. spelling, digucchā, occurs at DhsA 210.
jighacchati: Jighacchati [Desid. to ghasati, 먹고싶은 바람이 있다, 배고프다 D II.266; pp. jighacchita DhA II.145.
jighacchā: Jighacchā (f.) [from jighacchati] 식욕, 배고픔, 종종 pipāsā 와 결합, 마시고 싶어하는, 갈증난, e. g. S I.18; A II.143, 153; Miln 304. -- M I.13, 114; 364; III.97, 136; A III.163; Dh 203 (j. paramā rogā); J II.445; III.19; (°abhibhūta=chāta); Miln 204, 304; Sdhp 118, 388. Cp. khudā & chāta. Note. A diff. spelling as dighacchā occurs at A II.117.
jiñjuka: Jiñjuka Gunja 관목 (Abrus precatorius) J IV.333 (akkhīni j. °phalasadisāni, cp. in same application guñjā); V.156 (j. °phalasannibha); DhA I.177 (°gumba).
jiṇṇa: Jiṇṇa [pp. of jarati] 1. 부패한, 부서진, 부서지기 쉬운, 노쇠한, 낡은: vuDDha mahallaka andhagata vayo--anupatta Nd2 261; jarājiṇṇatāya jiṇṇa DA I.283. -- Vin II.189; D I.114; M II.48 sq., 66; A II.249; IV.173; Sn 1 (urago va jiṇṇaṁ tacaṁ jahāti); Pv I.121 (same simile); Sn 1120, 1144; J I.58; III.22 (--pilotikā 닳아빠진 깔개); Dh 155, 260; Pv II.114 (jarājiṇṇa PvA 147); Pug 33; Vism 119 (°vihārā), 356 (°sandamānikā), 357 (°koṭṭha); ThA 213 (--ghara 다 허물어져 가는 집); PvA 40 (--goṇQ=jaraggava), 55 (of a roof). Cp. °tara J IV.108. -- 2. digested J II.362
jiṇṇatā: Jiṇṇatā (f.) [cp. jiṇṇa, jaratā & jīraṇatā] 노쇠 DA I.283 (jarā°).
jita: Jita [pp. of jayati, conquer] 정복한, 제압한, 통달한: (nt.) 승리. jitā me pāpakā dhammā Vin I.8; <-> Dh 40, 104 (attā jitaṁ seyyo for attā jito seyyo see DhA II.228), 105, 179; Vv 6427 (jitindriya one whose senses are mastered, cp. guttindriya). -- Cp. vi°.
jitatta: Jitatta (nt.) [n. abstr. of jita] 지배, 정복 VvA 284.
jina: Jina [pp. med. of jayati] 정복한, 승리의, 종종 붓다에 대해, "승리자": jitā me pāpakā dhammā tasmâhaṁ Upaka jino ti Vin I.8=M I.171; Vin V.217; Sn 379, 697, 989, 996. magga° 도를 정복한 사람 Sn 84 sq.; saṁsuddha° (id.) Sn 372. Cp khetta°. In other connections: Pv IV.333; Th 2, 419 (jin'amhase rūpinaṁ Lacchiṁ expld at ThA 268 as jinā amhase jinā vat'amha rūpavatiṁ Siriṁ). --cakka 붓다의 지배, 통치, 권위 J IV.100; --putta 붓다의 훈육 Miln 177; --bhūmi 정복자의 바탕, 기반 PvA 254; --sāsana 붓다의 교리. Dpvs IV.3, 10.
jimha: Jimha (adj.) [Vedic jihma] 휘어진, 완곡한, 기울어진, 비유적으로, 불량한, 그릇된 (cp. vanka, opp. uju | M I.31 (+vanka); A V.289, 290; J I.290 (spelled jima); III.111=V.222; VI.66; Vism 219 (ajimha=uju); PvA 51 (citta° vanka . . .; opp. uju). Cp. kuṭila.
jimhatā: Jimhatā (f.) [n. abstr. to jimha] 뒤틀림, 기만 (opp. ujutā) Dhs 50, 51 (+vankatā); Vbh 359.
jimheyya: Jimheyya (nt.) [from jimha] 뒤틀림, 기만, 사기 M I.340 (sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni vankeyyāni j.°); A IV.189 (id.) V.167.
jiyā: Jiyā (f.) [Vedic jyā=Gr. bio/s bow, cp. also Lat. filum thread] 활 줄 M I.429 (five kinds); J II.88; III.323; Vism 150; DA I.207. --kāra 활줄 만드는 사람 Miln 331.
jivhā: Jivhā (f.) [Vedic jihvā, cp. Lat. lingua (older dingua); Goth. tuggo; Ohg. zunga; E. tongue] 혀. <-> (a) 신체적으로: Vin I.34; A IV.131; Sn 673, 716; Dh 65, 360; J II.306; PvA 99 (of Petas: visukkha--kanthaṭṭha j.), 152. – 귀까지 닿아서 자기 이마를 덮을 수 있는 mahāpurusha 의 혀: Sn 1022; p. 108; & pahūta--jivhatā 두드러진 혀를 가진 가진 것에 대한 특징 (32 Mahāpurisa--lakkhaṇāni 의27 번째) D I.106=Sn p. 107; D II.18. --dujjivha (adj.) 나쁜 혀를 가진 (독뱀에 대해서) A III.260. -- (b) 심리적으로: 미각. 감각 기관의 열거에서 네 번째 감각으로 ghāna (냄새) 에 뒤따라 온다 (jivhāya rasaṁ sāyati Nd2 under rūpa; jivhā--viññeyya rasa D I.245; II.281; M II.42) Vin I.34; D III.102, 226; M I.191; Vism 444. --agga 혀의 끄트머리 A III.109; IV.137; DhA II.33. --āyatana 맛의 기관 D III.243, 280, 290; Dhs 585, 609, 653; --indriya 미각 D III.239; Dhs 585, 609, 972; --nittaddana (corr. to --nitthaddhana) 주술로 혀를 묶음 D I.11 (cp. DA I.96); --viññāṇa 맛의 인지 M I.112; D III.243; Dhs 556, 612, 632; --samphassa 미각과 접촉함 S I.115; D III.243; Dhs 585, 632, 787.
